allocation.method: exact subset-sum nearest 20% of eligible rows, intact evaluation blocks
allocation.tie_break: SHA-256 block order; nearest integer row target, lower row total on equal distance

diagnostics_credibility_rule.use: structural limited-holdout feasibility only, not proof of generalization

eligibility: unchanged Stage 2.3C eligible population; no outcome trimming, imputation or new exclusions
holdout_rules: No holdout outcomes for feature selection, model choice, tuning, early stopping, scaling or vocabulary fitting
Target/category tables are post-allocation descriptive diagnostics; no allocation reselection
Complete and lock primary models/configuration and primary final results before sensitivity fitting
Sensitivity train sets can contain primary holdout rows; sensitivity results must never feed back into primary choices
Freeze candidate models and hyperparameters using development data before opening test results
Report all predeclared scenarios; do not choose the best split or grouping by test performance
No inference about independently verified projects, historical ground truth, working days or deployment readiness
label_provenance: exploratory reported timestamps; no verified historical labels released

prior_stage_counts.future_experiment_policy: Minimal as-exported text/context features only, conservative grouped evaluation, exact repeats excluded, conflict/outcome-text quarantine; no original-baseline or deployment claim
prior_stage_counts.label_class: Exploratory reported timestamps; not verified historical ground truth, adjusted AOD, working duration or IFC delay
prior_stage_counts.target: Reported completed-activity elapsed calendar days = naive Actual_Finish_Date minus Actual_Start_Date divided by 86400 seconds

validation.large_block: report validation with this block withheld separately; do not split it to balance folds
validation.learned_text_vocabulary_and_category_map: fit inside each development training fold; unknown categories supported
validation.method: largest-block-first into smallest row-count fold; deterministic SHA-256 ties
validation.model_selection: training-only grouped validation, mean macro-block MAE; no holdout-based choices
